Label: AHR
Comment: Ligand-activated basic helix-loop-helix PAS transcription factor.

Label: AHRR
Comment: AHR repressor; an AHR target gene that competes with AHR for ARNT.

Label: NQO1
Comment: NAD(P)H quinone dehydrogenase 1; induced through the xenobiotic response element.

Label: TIPARP
Comment: TCDD-inducible poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase; an AHR target gene that feeds back on AHR.
